messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx + 429 observed for /v1/embeddings in ap-southeast-1 — error rate 16% over 5m, latency P95 x2. Auto-pager to @ryan (oncall).

ryan (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Who pushed any quota/config changes in the last 10m?

nimra (sre): looking at traces. I see quota-controller returning a lot of 429s starting at 02:18 UTC, followed by gateway 502s and then some 504s when upstream timed out.

josh (quota): we did a small experiment rollout at 02:15 to try per-tenant adaptive limits for high-concurrency users. It was scoped to label key tier:beta but I see the selector matched `tier` without namespace so it matched more tenants than intended.

anya (runtime): Also seeing KV cache churn at 02:17 which correlates with request fanout. Gateways are getting blocked waiting on quota-control RPCs. Sample log lines: 

```
[2026-03-13T02:19:04Z] quota-control warn id=qc-22 status=429 tenant=media-77 reason="burst-exceeded"
[2026-03-13T02:19:06Z] gateway error id=gw-881 upstream=quota-control status=502 msg="upstream returned error"
[2026-03-13T02:20:01Z] gateway error id=gw-882 upstream=embeddings-svc status=504 msg="upstream timeout waiting on quota-check"
```

ryan (oncall): Ok. Mitigation options: A) rollback experiment, B) flip quota fallback to soft-allow and add best-effort route, C) increase quota-service replicas, D) enlarge token-buckets for the region. Which is fastest to reduce customer impact?

nimra (sre): Fastest is rollback + soft-allow. Rolling back stops new selectors applying; soft-allow makes quota-control return a 200 with a warn header so gateway can proceed instead of failing.

josh (quota): I'll remove the experiment rollout from the canary group now. Command: 

```
DELETE https://quota-admin.internal/v1/rollouts/exp-adaptive-2026-03-13
Auth: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}
```

josh (quota): rollout deleted. Confirmed no active expansion selectors.

anya (runtime): I'm toggling quota fallback to best-effort for ap-southeast-1: 

```
PATCH https://runtime-config.internal/v1/regions/ap-southeast-1/overrides
Body: { "quota_fallback_mode": "best_effort" }
```

anya (runtime): fallback toggled. Gateways will now proceed on soft-deny.

nimra (sre): Observability: 429s dropped from 14% -> 1.8% within 4m. Gateway 502/504s reduced. KV eviction trending down.

tess (support): Notifying affected customers: sending short blurb — "We detected degraded generation/embedding performance 02:15-02:22 UTC. Mitigation applied, investigating root cause." Tagging high-impact tenants.

product-ops: Need initial impact summary: how many tenants received errors vs latency? Any SLAs breached?

nimra (sre): Quick mapping: 5 mid-tier tenants saw >10% errors, ~12 tenants saw transient latency. No enterprise SLA breaches detected so far. I'll run full impact query and attach to ticket.

ryan (oncall): Next steps: keep the rollback in place, leave best-effort fallback for the next 30 minutes while we confirm stability, schedule postmortem and assign owners. Who will own RCA and who will add pre-deploy guard?

josh (quota): I'll own selector validation and add a preflight that rejects selectors matching >1% of tenants. Also adding a dry-run mode that reports exact matched tenant list before rollout.

anya (runtime): I'll implement an emergency route in the gateway to switch quota-checks to async when quota-control latency > 250ms for 2 consecutive minutes. Also adding an alert for KV cache churn tied to config pushes.

tess (support): I'll prepare customer follow-ups and collect affected request IDs for debugging attachment.

pagerduty-bot: Created INCIDENT-1767012345, assigned to nimra (RCA), josh (quota guard), anya (runtime mitigation), tess (customer comms).

ryan (oncall): Metrics stable for 15m, 429s <0.5%, 5xx back to baseline. I'll stay on for 30m then hand to next oncall. Please keep channel updated with any anomalies.

nimra (sre): Filing postmortem draft now. Initial root cause: selector scoping bug in deploy script (missing namespace in label key) which caused a broader-than-intended rollout. Contributing factors: no preflight for selector match size, no gateway async fallback for quota-control, and monitoring didn't surface the experiment quickly enough.

josh (quota): Adding tests to rollout tooling: require explicit namespace in selector keys, warn on selectors matching >0.5% of tenant inventory.

anya (runtime): I'll add the async quota-check circuit and a quick rollback play in the runbook. Also scheduling a short meeting with quota team to review rollout process.

tess (support): Sent follow-up comms to affected tenants with incident ticket reference INCIDENT-1767012345 and ETA for RCA.

product-ops: Schedule a 30m postmortem review with SRE, runtime, quota, support tomorrow EOD. Include exec summary and customer impact table.

ryan (oncall): Closing pager for now. Leaving thread open until postmortem is published. Thanks everyone, great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
